Assign canonical IDs and preserve legacy names as aliases/provenance where appropriate.
After canonical intake, return the approved cases to the dossier queue for G02 evidence-corpus work.
Do not freeze the Protocolometry scoring Pilot 20 until the eligible resolved pool satisfies the published selection protocol.
public_boundary: This ledger is an internal/pre-v1 entity-resolution control. It does not itself add records to REV7, approve dossiers, create scores or publish a ranking.
